negative_snippets:
Very bad experience., especially with the front desk. They don't allow food and drinks from outside.... probably part of their policy. However they charge an additional fee of rs 500 for the same. it is not mentioned anywhere in the policy this adding it to confusion. I booked my room through Agoda which clearly mentioned food and drinks discount, but I had to argue for the same. They don't even allow your guests inside the room even with a valid i.d which I have never seen before. When asked for reasons, they keep saying it's our hotel policy..in a rude manner.
Even most of the 5 star hotels don't object ur valid visitors.

Room Service was very slow...we waited for 20 minutes just for having glasses in our room.
Then the bill for room dining was incorrect and high (intentional or not?). I had to call them to rectify it.

The only thing which was good was the breakfast (though limited items) and the way it was served. Special mention for Mr Vikas and Pinky who were prompt and polite, and paid heed to our request. They were the only shining stars for this hotel.

Will not recommend this place to anyone.

I organized my daughter’s birthday celebration here with over 100 guests, but unfortunately the experience was disappointing. The sales team was extremely inefficient and did not meet expectations. They seemed more focused on maximizing profit rather than ensuring the event was well organized and that the client was satisfied.

The hotel’s poor location and weak infrastructure especially noticeable in the parking area already make things challenging, and the unprofessional attitude of the sales staff only made the experience worse. I would not recommend this place for hosting events.

One of the worst hotel experiences due to poor policies and management. Guests are charged ₹500 extra for carrying their own bottle, outside food is not allowed, and a ₹3000 security deposit is mandatory. The staff conducts very detailed bag checks, opening every pocket and zip, which feels quite uncomfortable. Rooms are average overall not worth the experience.
